title: Boro Bible: Gwdan Radab (New Testament) & Agan Radab (Old Testament)
translators: Rev. C. Bechtold (1906), Rev. A. Kristiansen (1935), Bible Society of India (BSI)

structure.key_books: Genesis (सिर्जिनाय), Exodus (ओंखारनाय), Psalms (थुबुर मेथाइ), Proverbs (बाथ्रा फाव), Isaiah (यशायाह).
Matthew (माथिय), Mark (मार्क), Luke (लुक), John (जहन), Acts (थायनाय), Romans (रोमिया), Revelation (फोसावनाय).

key_scriptures.bodo_dev: गिबियाव इसोरा अख्रां आरो हाखौ सिर्जिबाय।
key_scriptures.bodo_rom: Gibiyao Iswra okhrang aro hakhwo sirjibay.
key_scriptures.english: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

key_scriptures.bodo_dev: मानोना इसोरा बुहुमखौ एसेबां मोजां मोनबाय, जे बिहा गावनि सासेल' फिसाखौ हरबाय, जाहाथे बियाव फोथायग्रा गासैबो गोमाना थाङा, नाथाय जोबनो गैयै जिउ मोनगोन।
key_scriptures.bodo_rom: Manwna Iswra buhumkhwo esebang mwjang mwnbay, je biha gawni saselw fisakhwo hwrbay, jahathe biyao fothaygra gasaybw gwmana thanga, nathay jwbnw gwywi jiu mwngwn.
key_scriptures.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

key_scriptures.bodo_dev: प्रभुवा आंनि गोजां गोजां दावथुआ, आंहा जेबोनिबो गोमानाय जानो हाया।
key_scriptures.bodo_rom: Probhuwa angni gwojang gwojang daothua, angha jebwnibw gwmanay janw haya.
key_scriptures.english: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
